GET_ADMIN_ANALYTICS_LOCATION_FUNNEL.details: Returns location-wise funnel data with city, state, country, lat/lng, page_views, product_views, add_to_cart, checkout_started, anonymous_visitors, anonymous_cart_adds

IP_BASED_GEOLOCATION_HOOK.details: useAnalytics.js uses ip-api.com for geolocation without permission popup. Falls back to ipinfo.io. Caches location for performance.

ANALYTICS_LOCATION_TAB.details: Location tab displays correctly at /admin/analytics with proper tabs navigation

SUMMARY_CARDS.details: 4 cards displayed - Total Locations (7), Anonymous Visitors (9), Cart Adds No Login (3), Checkouts Started (1)

OPENSTREETMAP_INTEGRATION.details: Map displays using OpenStreetMap embed iframe with zoom controls and Reset button

PIN_MARKERS.details: Pin markers displayed on map overlay. Colors: blue (page views only), amber (cart adds), green (checkout started). Shows event count badge.

LOCATION_FUNNEL_TABLE.details: Table with columns: Location, Page Views, Product Views, Add to Cart, Checkout, Anonymous %, Conv. Rate. Shows data for Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Noida

TOP_CITIES_SECTIONS.details: Two sections: 'Top Cities - Anonymous Cart Adds' (Mumbai, Delhi, TestCity) and 'Top Converting Locations' (Delhi with 100% conv rate)

MAP_LEGEND.details: Legend shows: Page Views Only (blue), Added to Cart (amber), Started Checkout (green)

ANONYMOUS_USER_TRACKING.details: Anonymous visitors and cart adds tracked without login. anonymous_visitors and anonymous_cart_adds fields populated in API response
